integrity: All-size results proved algebraically. A finite exact-arithmetic checker corroborates, but does not replace, the proof. An equivalent arithmetic resonance in older Terwilliger-algebra work remains a risk.
scientific_limitations: Binary Walsh degree at most two; exact interior Hamming shells n>=5, 2<=k<=n-2. No larger-degree/nonbinary conclusions. Arithmetic collision classification is not claimed to be independent of standard Johnson representation theory.
title: Square-dimension spectral resonances for quadratic-band Walsh concentration on Hamming shells
